quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Osaka Cement press release: release 88754 (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Demonstration (cement / carbon business): Sumitomo Osaka Cement and INPEX, jointly researching since August 2023, have started demonstration testing of a Ca-Looping technology that captures CO2 by repeatedly using calcium compounds, converting it into calcium carbonate that can be transported at normal temperature and pressure; the test equipment is installed at the National Maritime Research Institute (Mitaka, Tokyo). The first target is installation on large vessels facing tighter international CO2 rules. The company says its SOCN2050 Version 2.0 carbon-neutral vision (revised May 2026) includes artificial-limestone manufacture and use and CCS studies with partners, and it aims to create a carbon business from this work.
